# Operation coverage

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_ops.py from ops.toml. Do not edit. -->

52 of 52 operations run on the device in a compiled graph. Anything else
runs on the host through PyTorch's CPU implementation.

Elementwise operations are fused into shared loops, reductions get a kernel each, and
movement operations are views with no kernel. Matmuls call cuBLAS and convolution calls
cuDNN. A node with a keyword argument its kernel does not read, such as `alpha` or GELU's
`approximate`, runs on the host. Custom operations are not listed here; see
`tessiq.library.registered()`.

`tools/model_coverage.py` reports coverage for real model blocks.

| Operation | ATen | Category | Runs on device |
